metadata.title: Curvature-Dimension Conditions Along Discrete Refinement Sequences
metadata.abstract: We introduce the sequence curvature--dimension condition $SCD(K,N)$ for complete refinement systems of finite metric probability spaces. The condition couples a transport action bound with entropy comparisons along a single probability section through the prescribed refinement layers. Within a bounded comparison range, we prove that midpoint comparisons on three consecutive layers characterize the condition on every fixed finite segment. If, in addition, the refinement sequence converges in the measured sense in its intrinsic bridge realization, then $SCD(K,N)$ is equivalent both to the vanishing of single-layer midpoint defects and to the entropic curvature--dimension condition $CD^{e}(K,N)$ of the limit. In the reverse direction, a $CD^{e}(K,N)$ bound on the limit yields quantitative recovery estimates that identify shrinking transport scales on which finite layers retain its second-order curvature comparison. These estimates are uniform over endpoint measures and include Dirac masses. Examples illustrate the effects of the refinement rule, the layer metrics and the reference measures.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 离散细化曲率条件与连续极限
analysis.workSummary: 作者对有限度量概率空间的完备细化系统定义SCD(K,N)，沿指定细化层的单一概率截面耦合运输作用量与熵比较。在有界比较范围内，连续三层中点比较刻画每个固定有限段上的条件；若序列还在其内禀bridge实现中按测度意义收敛，则SCD等价于单层中点缺陷消失及极限的CD^e(K,N)。
techniques: 细化层之间的运输作用量与熵比较
连续曲率界的定量离散恢复
analysis.breakthrough: 从极限CD^e界反推有限层保留二阶曲率比较的收缩运输尺度，恢复估计对端点测度一致并包含Dirac质量，连接离散规则和合成曲率。
analysis.limitations: 连续极限等价依赖完备细化系统、有界比较范围及指定实现中的测度收敛，不能写成任意离散逼近都自动保持CD界。SCD为作者新定义，不能与既有单个图的曲率维数条件混同。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。54页PDF完整提取、页数匹配、无短文本页；全文与元数据检索及A.I.、断行/连字符模型名、Danus补检未发现作者AI使用披露。未观察到披露不等于确认没有使用。

analysis.priorityReason: 直接涉及度量测度极限、合成曲率和运输，是与用户研究高度相关的框架性进展。
